# Ronning Systems, LLC

> Independent consultancy providing FDA audit readiness, systems engineering, and technical facilitation for medical device and aviation teams. Based in the Portland, OR metro area and founded by Patrick Ronning.

Ronning Systems helps regulated-product teams ship reliable systems: design controls, risk management, verification and validation, and audit-ready quality processes. Past work spans medical devices (BrightInsight, Oregon State Hospital), aerospace (Virgin Orbit), and wearables (Garmin).
